title: pulldown-cmark default-features not disabled in fieldwork
description: fieldwork/Cargo.toml line 21: pulldown-cmark = { version = "0.12", optional = true } enables default features. Downstream servers smallhold and gaja both specify default-features = false, features = ["html"], intending minimal compilation. Since Cargo unifies features additively, the servers end up with pulldown-cmark's full default feature set anyway when using fieldwork. Fix: add default-features = false, features = ["html"] to fieldwork's pulldown-cmark dep to respect downstream intent.
close_reason: Fixed: pulldown-cmark now has default-features = false, features = [html]
